verses.text: Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach' spensar. Ha swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek a onh israel onh tik to a swach'k'olal Jehová aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Yalokab' heb' sacerdote to a swach'k'olal Jehová aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek a onh ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh to a swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ay in wal och t'a in yaelal, ix in awaj t'a Jehová, ix yab' in lesal, ix in skolaneli.
Ayek' Jehová wet'ok, manh ol in xiwlaj yuj tas ol in yutok heb' wetanimail.
Ayek' Jehová wet'ok, yujto a tzin kolani, yuj chi' ol wil yak'ji ganar heb' tzin chakaneli.
Yelxo wal te wach' tato skak'och Jehová yipok ko k'ool t'a yichanh to a heb' ketanimail skak'och yipok ko k'ool.
Yelxo wal te wach' tato skak'och Jehová yipok ko k'ool t'a yichanh to a heb' yajal skak'och yipok ko k'ool.
Ix och hoyan masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a in patik wichanh, palta yuj spoder Jehová ix wak' ganar heb'.
Ix och hoyan heb' t'ayin icha wal nok' nok'al chab', haxo yowal heb' chi' ix tupkanel icha stup te' k'ak' t'a junok te' takinh k'iix. Yuj spoder Jehová ix wak' ganar heb'.
Tzin yek telwok heb' t'a smasanil yip snaani, palta haxo Jehová sjawi in skolo'.
Tzin b'itan t'a Jehová. Ha tz'ak'anoch wip, in Kolumal yaji.
Ha t'a spat heb' anima tojol spensar ay b'it yet' tzalajk'olal, yujto ix yak' ganar owal heb' yuj spoder Jehová te satub'tak.
Yuj spoder Jehová chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb' ajk'ool. Satub'tak yoch spoder chi'.
Manto ol in chamlaj, palta ayto in k 'inal yik wach' ol walel tas ix sb'o Jehová wet'ok.
Te niwan in yaelal ix yak'a', palta maj in scha chamlaj.
Jakek spuertail stemplo Dios Tojol. In gana tzin ochi yik swak' yuj diosal t'ay ta'.
Haton jun tik spuertail b'aj tzonh k'och t'a yichanh Jehová. Hata' ol ochk'och heb' tojol sb'eyb'al.
Swak' yuj diosal t'ayach Jehová yujto ix ach tak'wi t'ayin, in Kolumal ach.
Ha jun k'een k'een malaj yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' b'oum pat, haton k'een ix ochkan sjolomok schikin te' pat chi'.
Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová. Yuj chi' ayik skilani, ste sat ko k'ool yuj.
Haton t'a jun k'u tik ix yak'elk'och Jehová tas nab'ilkan yuj, yuj chi' tzonh tzalaj tiknaik, tz'el lenaj skila'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh k'elan t'ayonh, kolonheli, wach'okab' tzonh ajkan uuj.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jun chekb'ilkot yuj Jehová. Skal wach' lolonel t'ayex mach ex molan ex ek' t'a stemplo Jehová.
Ha Jehová Dios toni, a tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'ayonh. Kak'ekoch k'inh, skik'ankot skab' te te' ay xiil, tzonh ek'ek oyoyok t'a spatik altar.
Skak' yuj diosal t'ayach Mamin, yujto ko Diosal ach, skal wach' lolonel t'ayach, tzach kik'anchaanh.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto te wach' spensar. Ha swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
